L50: In order to receive a transcript evaluation, you’ll need to request an official transcript from your prior institution. Acceptable official college transcripts are issued directly from the institution by mail or electronically.
L51: ## Mail
L52: 
L53: Transcripts sent by mail should arrive in the original sealed envelope to be counted as official.
L54: 
L55: Please send all official college transcripts to:
L56: Liberty University Online Admissions Verification
L57: 1971 University Blvd.
L58: Lynchburg, VA  24515
L59: ## Electronically
L60: 
L61: An official transcript can also be submitted through an electronic transcript database provider such as Scrip-Safe, Docufide, Parchment, National Student Clearinghouse, or others.  This electronic transcript should be sent directly to Liberty via the school’s system. When an email address is requested, please use luoverify@liberty.edu.
L62: ## International
L63: 
L64: If you have completed secondary education or college-level academic coursework outside of the U.S. please have your transcripts evaluated by a credential evaluation service provider that is a member of the 【14†National Association of Credential Services (NACES^{®})†www.naces.org】.
L65: 
L66: * * *
L67: ## General Transfer Information:
L68:   * Accreditation: Regionally or Nationally Accredited Institution, approved through the 【15†Department of Education†ope.ed.gov】
L69:     * 【16†Institutional Challenge Exams (ICE)】 are recommended if you have attended unaccredited Bible colleges or institutes
L70:   * Grades: Grade of C or higher.  Grades of P/P+ are eligible to transfer as long as the grading system at the transfer institution states that “P” or “P+” is equivalent to C- or better.  Grades of P/P- are not able to transfer if they are not equivalent to “C-” or better.
L71:   * Equivalency: Coursework must be similar in content and scope of courses offered at Liberty University.  Courses that are not significantly similar to a Liberty University course by may transfer as elective credit.   Elective credit is coded as 1XX, 2XX, 3XX or 4XX, depending on the level of the course
L72:   * Credit Hours: Minimum credit hour requirement met
L73: ### Non-Tr ansferable Courses
L74: 
L75:   * Remedial courses (usually numbered 1-99)
L76:   * Grades of Pass/Fail or Satisfactory (unless P is equivalent to a C or higher on the transcript)
L77:   * Continuing Education Credits (CEU) – an exception may be made for recommendations by the American Council on Education (ACE)
L78: 
L79: ### Transfer Age Limit
L80: 
L81: #### Five-Year Age Limit
L82: 
L83:   * All upper-level ACCT courses
L84:   * All CSIS courses
L85:   * All CSCN courses
L86: #### Ten-Year Age Limit
L87:   * DIGI 175 (Fundamentals of Editing)
L88:   * DIGI 224 (Fundamentals of Audio Production)
L89:   * DIGI 225 (Introduction to Video Production)
L90:   * DIGI 230 (Essential Production Tools)
L91:   * DIGI 250 (Location Sound)
L92:   * DIGI 282 (Intermediate Editing and Effects)
L93:   * DIGI 290 (Post Production Sound Design)
L94:   * DIGI 327
L95:   * DIGI 333 (Intermediate Video Production)
L96:   * DIGI 334 (Intermediate Audio Production)
L97:   * DIGI 337 (Music Recording)
L98:   * DIGI 370 (Studio Production)
L99:   * DIGI 454 (Radio News Production)
L100:   * DIGI 474 (Advanced Audio Production)
L101:   * DIGI 483 (Advanced Video Production)
L102:   * DIGI 490 (SFX, ADR and Foley)
L103: ## Courses Transferable Under Special Conditions
L104: 
L105:   * Capstone courses from another institution are not able to fulfill Liberty’s capstone requirements
L106:   * Internships or practicum courses from another institution transfer as elective credit only
L107:   * Seminars and workshops only transfer if the course is a standard college course offered on a regular basis with a standard syllabus
L108:   * Varsity or intramural Sports only transfer if college-level and averaged into GPA at previous school
L109: ## Additional Credit Hour Information
L110: 
L111: Coursework must be at least 2/3rds the number of hours required by Liberty.  For example, BUSI 310 is taught as a 3 semester hour course.  In order to receive credit for BUSI 310, the transfer course must be at least 2 semester credits. This satisfies the 2/3 rule.
L112: 
L113: The 2/3 rule may create a shortage of credit hours (all coursework is met, but a total of 60 or 120 hours is not). Additional credit must be taken to meet the credit hour requirement.
L114: If the institution attended was based on a quarter system, then the credits will be converted to the semester system. Liberty uses the following conversion rate:  1 QH = .67 SH
